figures.finding: No one under eighteen may be appointed or hold office as a director of a Tongan company; only a natural person not otherwise disqualified may be a director.
figures.applies: Companies Act (1995, 2020 Revised Edition) s. 150, Attorney General's Office legislation site.

sources.said: 150 Qualifications of directors (1) A natural person who is not disqualified by subsection (2) may be appointed as a director of a company. (2) The following persons are disqualified from being appointed or holding office as a director of a company: (a) a person who is under 18 years of age;
